verdict.rationale: Temporal is explicitly Workflows-as-Code rather than a no-code engine. Developers write Workflows and Activities with its Python and TypeScript SDKs, so every step in a workflow is real code. Community users note that workflow code must be deterministic, which is a constraint on that code rather than a lack of code steps. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party example of defining an Activity step in JavaScript or Python, and independent hands-on corroboration of writing code steps in those languages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow

citations.quote: Temporal isn't a no-code Workflow engine — it is Workflows-as-Code.
